events.title: 포주에서 태어나다
events.description: 포주에서 태어났다. 본적은 태원 기현이며, 어머니 최씨는 독실한 불교 신자로 그를 길렀다.
events.description_en: He was born in Puzhou. His family's ancestral home was Qi County in Taiyuan, and his mother, Lady Cui, a devout Buddhist, raised him in that faith.

events.title: 과거에 장원으로 급제해 태악승이 되다
events.title_en: He placed first in the state examination and became assistant director of music
events.description: 과거에 장원으로 급제해 태악승에 임명됐다. 음률에 밝아 궁정 음악을 관장하는 자리에 올랐다.
events.description_en: He placed first in the imperial examination and was appointed assistant director of the Court Music Office. His command of music brought him to a post overseeing the court's musical affairs.

events.title: 황사자무 사건으로 제주로 좌천되다
events.title_en: He was demoted to Jizhou over the Yellow Lion Dance affair
events.description: 그의 관할 아래 있던 악공이 황제만 볼 수 있는 황사자무를 함부로 추게 한 일로 책임을 지고 제주 사창참군으로 좌천됐다.
events.description_en: A musician under his charge performed the Yellow Lion Dance, a dance reserved for the emperor alone, and Wang Wei bore the blame. He was demoted to a granary post in Jizhou.

events.title: 장구령의 발탁으로 우습유가 되다
events.title_en: Zhang Jiuling promoted him to Right Reminder
events.description: 재상 장구령이 그를 눈여겨보고 우습유로 발탁해 다시 조정에 불러들였다.
events.description_en: Chancellor Zhang Jiuling took notice of him and brought him back to court, appointing him Right Reminder.

events.title: 남전에 망천별업을 짓기 시작하다
events.title_en: He began building the Wangchuan estate at Lantian
events.description: 남전 망천에 별장을 마련해 손보기 시작했다. 벗 배적과 함께 이 골짜기를 오가며 시를 주고받았다.
events.description_en: He began developing a country estate at Wangchuan in Lantian. With his friend Pei Di he wandered its valley and exchanged poems.

events.title: 어머니를 여의고 상을 치르다
events.title_en: His mother died and he observed mourning
events.description: 독실한 불교도였던 어머니 최씨가 세상을 떠났다. 망천별업에 머물며 상을 치렀다.
events.description_en: His mother, Lady Cui, a devout Buddhist, passed away. He stayed at the Wangchuan estate to observe the mourning period.

events.title: 상을 마치고 이부낭중이 되다
events.title_en: After mourning he was appointed to the Ministry of Personnel
events.description: 삼년상을 마치고 조정에 복귀해 이부낭중에 임명됐다.
events.description_en: After completing the three-year mourning period he returned to court and was appointed a director in the Ministry of Personnel.

events.title: 안녹산 군에 붙잡혀 낙양으로 끌려가다
events.title_en: He was captured by An Lushan's forces and taken to Luoyang
events.description: 안녹산의 군대가 장안을 점령하면서 그도 붙잡혀 낙양으로 끌려갔다. 반란 정권의 관직을 받지 않으려고 귀머거리 행세를 했다.
events.description_en: When An Lushan's army took Chang'an he was captured and brought to Luoyang. He feigned deafness to avoid taking office under the rebel regime.

events.title: 억류 중에 「응벽지」를 짓다
events.title_en: He wrote 'Ningbi Pond' while held captive
events.description: 낙양에 억류된 동안 「응벽지」를 지어 무너진 나라를 슬퍼하고 조정을 그리는 마음을 담았다.
events.description_en: While held in Luoyang he wrote the poem 'Ningbi Pond,' mourning the fallen state and voicing his longing for the Tang court.

events.title: 동생의 탄원으로 사면을 받다
events.title_en: He was pardoned through his brother's plea
events.description: 당군이 수도를 되찾은 뒤 반란 정권에 협조한 죄로 문초를 받았다. 「응벽지」의 충심과, 자기 관직을 걸고 형을 구명한 동생 왕진의 탄원 덕에 사면됐다.
events.description_en: After Tang forces retook the capitals he was investigated for serving under the rebel regime. He was pardoned because of the loyalty shown in 'Ningbi Pond' and because his brother Wang Jin pleaded for him, offering his own rank to redeem him.

events.title: 배적과 『망천집』을 엮다
events.title_en: He compiled the Wangchuan Collection with Pei Di
events.description: 망천별업을 오가며 배적과 주고받은 시를 모아 『망천집』을 엮고, 그 풍경을 「망천도」로 그렸다.
events.description_en: He gathered the poems he and Pei Di had exchanged at Wangchuan into the Wangchuan Collection and painted the scenery as Wangchuan Tu.

events.title: 망천에서 세상을 떠나다
events.description_en: He died at Wangchuan at the age of sixty-one.
